comment: botl.c stat_update_time() delivers BL_TIME alone, and wintty.c re-fits the status row from the condition bits bot() last delivered. A level-30 wizard-mode Priest carrying 60000 gold, with a hostile jackal and #wizintrinsic giving five turns of fatal illness and longer stun, confusion, hallucination, blindness, deafness, slippery fingers, wounded legs and levitation, has a status row that overflows even after make_things_fit() shrinks it. On the fatal turn the jackal's bite is on the top line when timeout.c nh_timeout() lets the illness timeout reach zero and urgent_pline()s "You die from your illness."; that pline's flush runs timebot(), and the --More-- screen must keep "Ill" from the delivered bits although the hero's illness timeout is already zero.
